traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and requirements for story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are implemented and verified: - File-level @supports in test files is enforced with a clear error message and safe auto-fix (REQ-TEST-FILE-SUPPORTS). - describe()/context() descriptions must include a story reference matching a configurable pattern; violations yield a specific 'describe() block should reference story' message (REQ-TEST-DESCRIBE-STORY). - it()/test() names must start with a '[REQ-XXX]' style prefix; malformed or missing prefixes are detected and can be auto-normalized with clear messaging (REQ-TEST-IT-REQ-PREFIX, REQ-TEST-ERROR-CONTEXT). - Test file detection is pattern-based and configurable, and non-test files are excluded (REQ-TEST-PATTERN-DETECT). - Multiple test frameworks are supported via recognition of describe/it/test/context and MemberExpression variants (REQ-TEST-FRAMEWORK-COMPAT, REQ-TEST-NESTED-DESCRIBE). - Correctness of @supports annotations themselves is delegated to existing valid-annotation-format, valid-story-reference, and valid-req-reference rules already enabled in the recommended/strict configs, satisfying REQ-TEST-SUPPORTS-VALID while reusing prior infrastructure. - The rule is registered in the plugin, enabled in recommended/strict configurations, thoroughly unit-tested in tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts, and documented in README and user-docs. - The latest Jest run in this assessment shows the require-test-traceability test suite (explicitly referencing this story) passing alongside the rest of the project.
Based on the current code, tests, and documentation, this story is fully implemented and passes all specified acceptance criteria.
